Raj: Quick sync — proposing a 'Prime Path' for model catalog entries. TL;DR: three onboarding lanes (prime, compatibility, experimental). Prime Path = the small set of models we recommend by default for hosted and dedicated customers. I laid out a draft in the doc: https://rwd.internal/docs/catalog/prime-path-proposal. Key decision points: minimal benchmark set, default pin TTL, soft-pin rollout pattern, migration runway, and enterprise opt-in flow. Need decisions by EOD Fri to lock roadmap inclusion. Thoughts?

Elaine: +1 to lanes. Quick Q — what do you mean by minimal benchmark? latency + quality + cost?

Raj: Exactly. Suggested minimum (draft): latency (hosted P95), core quality evals, and token-cost baseline. Short snippet from the doc: ```bench_min:
- p95_latency_ms: 200
- eval_sets: ['core-kitchen', 'customer-critical']
- quality_thresholds: {qa_pass_rate: 0.90}
- cost_baseline_per_1k_tokens_usd: 0.12```

Sam: For pin TTL — my vote is 90 days default. Many enterprise customers ask for longer but 90d gives us runway to iterate and still unblocks migrations.

Maria: +1 90d default. For enterprise we should formalize a "pin exception" process tied to SOW (legal + sales signoff). Also auto-notify cadence: 30/14/7 days before expiration.

Elaine: We need a compatibility shim policy for embedding schema/shape changes. Embed breakages are common and customers hate silent regressions. Propose a compatibility flag on catalog entries that triggers extra integration tests and a longer soft-rollout.

Raj: Good call. Also proposing a soft-pin/soft-rollout pattern: route 10% traffic to new version for 2 weeks, collect perf/quality signals, then 50/50 for 3 days, then cutover. If regression detected, auto-fallback to previous pinned version. Policy: soft-rollout can be skipped only with exec signoff.

devbot: PR opened: #4821 "prime-path-onboarding-spec" by raj — https://git.internal/r/redwood/catalog/pulls/4821

Sam: Owners to implement: Raj (product) to finalize spec + comms, Sam (eng-runtime) to own soft-rollout routing + fallback, Elaine (eval) to own bench suite + acceptance scripts, Maria (sales) to own pin-exception SOW template and customer comms.

Raj: Meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am to lock decisions and finalize action items. Agenda + checklist in the doc. If there are no serious objections, I'll merge the spec on Friday and start rolling the prime path into the Q3 roadmap. :calendar:

Elaine: ack

Maria: ack — I'll prep SOW template draft before Thu meeting

Sam: ack — will scope runtime changes and bring a playbook for rollback

Raj: Thanks everyone. We'll track open items in the PR and follow up in the meeting.
